blocks.text: NOx reactions ke ek silsile mein hissa leta hai jo ozone, aldehydes, peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs) aur peroxybenzoyl nitrate (PBN) tak le jata hai. PAN peroxyacyl nitrates ka ek rukn hai, aam banawat RC(O)OONO2 (Figure 12.4); peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R CH3 hai, magar doosri hydrocarbon zanjeerein bhi ho sakti hain. PAN ka banna (Figure 12.5): oxidising smog ka bunyadi juz ozone hai, jo hydrocarbon ko aldehyde mein oxidise karti hai; aldehyde hydroxyl radical se react kar ke acyl radical deta hai; acyl radical oxygen se react kar ke peroxyacyl radical deta hai, jo aakhir mein nitrogen dioxide se react kar ke peroxyacyl nitrate banata hai.

blocks.alt: Banawat: R ek C se jura hai jis ke oopar double bond wala O hai; C ek O se, woh O doosre O se, aur woh N se jura hai. N par + charge hai, daen taraf double bond wala O aur neeche single bond wala O jis par manfi charge hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: PANs ki aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 12.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is banawat ke teen hisse hain: R-C(=O)- acyl group, beech mein -O-O- peroxy jor, aur aakhir mein -NO2 (nitro) group. Is liye aam formula RC(O)OONO2 hai. Jab R = CH3 ho to yeh peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) hai.

blocks.caption: PAN banne ka mechanism (Figure 12.5)
rows: O3 hydrocarbon RCH3 ko aldehyde RCHO mein oxidise karti hai
RCHO + HO. se acyl radical RC(=O).
RC(=O). + O2 se peroxyacyl radical RC(=O)OO.
RC(=O)OO. + NO2 se RC(=O)OONO2, peroxyacyl nitrate (PAN)

blocks.alt: Ek bayzavi (ellipse) cycle jis par teer ghari ki sooiyon ke rukh (clockwise) chalte hain. Reactive Hydrocarbon (sabz dabba) O3 se RCH2• deta hai jo cycle ke oopar hai; O2 se RCH2O2•; NO se RCH2O• + NO2; O2 se neeche HO2 + RCHO; HO2 aur NO se baen taraf NO2 + HO•; HO• aur RCH3 se dobara RCH2•. RCHO se neeche seedhi zanjeer: OH• se RC•=O, O2 se RC(=O)OO•, NO2 se RC(=O)OONO2.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: PAN banne ka mechanism (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cycle mein har chakkar NO ko NO2 mein badalta hai aur HO• radical wapas aa jata hai, is liye cycle chalta rehta hai. Aldehyde RCHO cycle se nikal kar neeche wali zanjeer mein jata hai: OH• us se acyl radical RC•=O banata hai, O2 se peroxyacyl radical RC(O)OO• banta hai, aur NO2 se PAN, RC(O)OONO2. Kitab ki shakal mein teen ghaltiyan hain jo hamare khaake mein theek ki gai hain: (1) RCH2• + O2 ke baad 'RCH2O•' chhapa hai, sahi RCH2O2• hai; (2) aakhri dabbe mein 'OONO3' chhapa hai, sahi OONO2 hai (PAN = RC(O)OONO2); (3) cycle ke baen aadhe mein teer ulte rukh mein hain, jabke HO2 + NO se NO2 + HO• aur HO• + RCH3 se RCH2• banne ke liye poora cycle ek hi rukh mein chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: PAN ka matlab kya hai, us ka aam formula dein, aur us ke banne ke zimmedar compounds batayein (Quick Check 12.2b, c).
blocks.explanation: Peroxyacyl nitrate (R = CH3 ho to peroxyacetyl nitrate), aam formula RC(O)OONO2. Yeh ozone se aldehydes mein oxidise hone wale hydrocarbons (VOCs), hydroxyl radicals, oxygen aur nitrogen dioxide se banta hai, jo sab NOx wali dhoop mein roshan hawa mein paida hote hain.

items: PAN = peroxyacyl nitrate RC(O)OONO2 (peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R = CH3); aldehyde (hydrocarbon + O3), HO. radical, O2 aur NO2 se acyl aur peroxyacyl radicals ke zariye banta hai.
